deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for priority consideration (fall only); later applications may be considered if space remains. Decisions by March 15.
deadline.quote: The application deadline is December 1. Applications received prior to the deadline will receive priority consideration, but applications received after the deadline may still receive consideration, pending available space.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required and scores sent are not factored in.
gre_general.quote: No, the GRE is not required. The committee will not factor in GRE scores sent to ASU.

gre_subject.value: No GRE scores, including Chemistry, are considered.
gre_subject.quote: No, the GRE is not required. The committee will not factor in GRE scores sent to ASU.

fee_waiver.value: The School of Molecular Sciences gives no fee waivers, but refunds the fee to admitted students who join.
fee_waiver.quote: The School of Molecular Sciences is unable to offer application fee waivers. | The application fee will be refunded to all students who are accepted into and agree to join our program.

supervisor.value: Admission is by the program, not individual professors; choose an advisor after joining.
supervisor.quote: all students, whichever professor they eventually work for, must first apply to and be accepted into the program. Individual professors do not make decisions regarding admissions and should not be contacted with admission inquiries.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students get a guaranteed TA/RA for five years; total annual stipend about USD 35,659 with tuition and health insurance.
funding.quote: All students accepted in the PhD Chemistry/Biochemistry programs are guaranteed financial support by means of a Graduate Assistant (Teaching/Research Assistant) position for five years. | Total annual stipend is $35,659.

entry_route.value: A 4-year BS in chemistry or a related field qualifies, but applicants with a 3-year Indian BSc must already have a master's.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor of Science degree in chemistry, biochemistry, or closely related discipline with appropriate coursework | Applicants from Indian institutions (3-yr BSc) must have completed a Master's degree.

notes: Two-step application: ASU general application plus SMS supplemental application. Competitive applicants usually have TOEFL 100 (speaking 23) or IELTS 7. A separate Biochemistry PhD (same school, same funding guarantee) also exists.
